newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron up 4 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Petron up 4 pct in late trade.

text.p: Philippine oil refiner Petron Corp gained 30 centavos, or four percent, to 7.80 pesos a share in late Thursday trade on a technical rebound after the issue plunged to an all-time low of 7.50 pesos a share on Wednesday, brokers said.

"Its also the market's initial reaction to the company's reported 35 percent increase in net income to 2.7 billion pesos for the first nine months from last year's 2 billion," said Spencer Yap, research head at BPI Capital Corp.
But brokers said the company posted improved nine month profits because it included its 1.3 billion pesos pending claims from the government's Oil Price Stabilisation Fund (OPSF).
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
A total of 14.1 million Petron shares worth 108.18 million pesos changed hands in late trade.
